expectations.text: Presents between three and five distinct options
Every option names the rhetorical figure it uses (or states 'no figure, diction only')
expectations.evidence: Treatment 1: None/Saxon; Treatment 2: Isocolon; Treatment 3: Anaphora.

expectations.text: No option uses negative parallelism; plain antithesis allowed only if both poles input-supported
Every option is shorter than the input tagline (fewer words)
expectations.evidence: Input ~29 words; T1 4 words, T2 7 words, T3 11 words.

expectations.text: No option adds a claim absent from the input
expectations.evidence: Treatment 3 'Make it work' and 'Make it land' add claims not supported in input.

expectations.text: Any candidate adding a claim is withdrawn, not presented with a caveat
expectations.evidence: No false positives presented with caveats.

expectations.text: Recommends one option and gives a reason
expectations.evidence: Recommends Treatment 1 with reasoning about compression.
